metadata.source: ERA5 hourly Earthmover icechunk; fdir normalized to DNI using integrated solar cosine

definition: Default taste from the production compact decoder. Nice means daily score >=55, perfect >=85, awful <25. Each of eight sampled days per month carries calendar month length / 8; counts round once over the complete period. Year=365 days; November through March=151 days. Ranking covers distinct named catalogue coordinates, sorted by rounded nice-day count, then typical score, perfect-day count, population and name. No population cutoff or geographic deduplication.
headlineDefinition: Separately, worldwideHeadline uses the production rankPlaces and inOutlookRegion functions: nice plus perfect days (perfect counts twice), population at least 300000, 250 km separation and its nearby-city naming rule. A cropped map or a different zoom can show different winners.
